title.narrative: Support to Guatemalan Gender Women Secretariat

description.narrative: By the end of the program, the Guatemalan Executive Branch institutions and the local Governments in the nine areas of implementation of the program, has incorporated Gender & Human Rights perspective in their policies, plans, programs, projects and budgets, according to the PNPDIM-PEO 2008-2023 and the international standards.

SEPREM är rådgivande organ för jämställdhetsfrågor och jämställdhetspolicy i Guatemalas regering. Insatsen helt i linje med nationella policyer och planer samt full harmoniserad med samarbetslandets system. Insatsen syftar till att stärka SEPREM och dess kapacitet att fullgöra sitt mandat.
Stödet ska ges via Guatemalas nationella konto och regleras av Guatemalas regler för hantering av offentliga medel.
Insatsen innehåller även en liten andra komponent för regional utbyte inom jämställdhetsområdet. Den är utformat som ett stöd för att möjliggöra utbyte mellan guatemalanska statliga organ på jämställdhetsområdet – som SEPREM och DEMI – och andra specialiserade organ i regionen som till exempel kvinnoinstituten i Costa Rica och Mexiko. Dessa utbyten är ännu inte planerade men ett budgetutrymme skapas för framtida behov genom denna komponent.

The intervention is relevant to the strategy for Development cooperation with Guatemala, within the sector Democratic Governance and human rights. SEPREM is the advisor & public policies coordinator agency for the Guatemalan Government in the area of women rights and gender issues. The program will support the implementation of the Multi annual Program 2014-2017, in eight departments of Guatemala.

sector.narrative: Public sector policy and administrative management
Women’s rights organisations and movements, and government institutions

description.narrative: During the four years of the project SEPREM reports making progress in 95% of the goals and indicators set in the results framework during the four years of the project 2016-2020. The reason for not achieving the full 100% can be understood in the light of Covid-19, i.e. inability for full project implementation during 2020. Some of the results are highlighted in the following areas: -Supporting the implementation of PNPDIM-PEO in public sector on central and territorial level, in relation to the General Politics of the Government and Agenda 2030. -Achieved in coordination with the Presidential Planning Secretariat (Segeplan) and the Ministry of Finance (MINFIN) 103 institutions on central level and 279 local governments made use of the tool for gender responsive budgeting. -Support to local women’s organisations in PNPDIM-PEO and capacity of dialogue in local coordination spaces, such as in the Council for urban and rural development. -Response to the National Voluntary Exam of progress of Agenda 2030 in coordination with Segeplan. -Support to the Ministry of Labour (MINTRAB) in elaborating a manual on how to handle sexual harassment and degrading treatment in workplaces. Institutional support to the gender units at the public institutions in implementing actions, routes, protocols and mechanisms for action that involve prevention, sanction, and action.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
